subject: Variable number of dateInputs in ui.R

messages.author: 4466c992e65f1ad8
messages.subject: Variable number of dateInputs in ui.R
parts:
Hi,

I am interested in deploying a time series forecaster in shiny.  I'd like to allow the user to be able to emphasize certain dates in the visualization and reporting, which can probably be resolved with dateInput.  However, what if there are an unknown number of date ranges that the user is interested in?  Is there a way I can design a ui.R that has a button which, when clicked on, will display a second, third, or nth dateInput that the user can use?

--
Jeffrey Wong

messages.author: fa8b9dad524607ca
messages.subject: Re: Variable number of dateInputs in ui.R
parts:
Indeed, you can have a variable number of input fields, here is a generalized version of code I have used

output$multipleInputs = renderUI({
lapply(1:numberOfInputs(), function(i){
#put whatever you want in here to format your input
x=c("a","b","c")
n="my title. note to self: change this"
checkboxGroupInput(paste("myinput",i,sep=""),n,choices=x,selected=NA)
})
})
